lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The SS Liberty is moored at Pier 96 in the fog[cite: 20].

lines.speaker: JACKIE
lines.text: This ends tonight. Rizzo's shipment comes in. Hit hard, hit clean[cite: 20].

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Silenced gunfire echoes across the deck. Nick 'The Nickel' is cornered and subdued[cite: 21, 22].
